# V4.7.0 Gore Magala 🌑

1. 导出的 PDF 重新带上排版样式和全部图片，V4.3.0 起导出会丢掉样式，没滚动到的图片也是空白
2. 预览里的图片在加载前就按原图比例留好位置，正文不再跟着跳动，加载慢的图片先显示一块轻轻呼吸的底色，视频直接显示第一帧
3. 预览模式下切换笔记不再整页重载，没有白闪，分栏编辑或外部改动时只刷新改到的段落，阅读位置保持不动
4. 预览的行距、字号和段落间距跟 iPhone 版统一成一套，中文强调不再显示成斜体，链接改用妙言绿
5. 窗口顶部的搜索框、笔记标题和模式按钮跟红绿灯放在同一行

---

1. Exported PDFs carry their styles and every image again; since V4.3.0 they lost the styling and images you had not scrolled to came out blank
2. Images in the preview hold their own shape before they load, so the text no longer jumps, a slow image shows a softly pulsing tint until it arrives, and videos show their first frame
3. Switching notes in preview no longer reloads the page or flashes blank, and split view or outside edits refresh only the changed paragraphs, keeping your place
4. The preview shares one set of line height, heading sizes and spacing with the iPhone app, Chinese emphasis stays upright, and links are MiaoYan green
5. The search field, note title and mode buttons sit on the same line as the window buttons
